notes:
⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium)

This site uses WordPress WP Job Manager plugin with AJAX-loaded listings. The listings are NOT in the initial HTML and require JavaScript execution.

Technical Details:
- Plugin: WP Job Manager
- Data loaded via AJAX to: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php
- Action parameter: job_manager_get_listings
- Empty container in static HTML: ul.job_listings
- Configured to show 100 items per page (data-per_page="100")
- Has filter form with category checkboxes and search
- Pagination: Load more button (a.load_more_jobs)

Alternative URLs to try:
- https://www.firststreetbusinessbrokers.com/opportunities/businesses-for-sale/ (Under $1M, 50 per page)
- https://www.firststreetbusinessbrokers.com/opportunities/larger-companies-for-sale/ (Over $1M)
- https://www.firststreetbusinessbrokers.com/opportunities/restaurants-for-sale/ (Restaurants)
- https://www.firststreetbusinessbrokers.com/opportunities/mls-business-listings-new-england/ (MLS listings)

Expected selectors (after JS renders):
- Container: ul.job_listings li.job_listing (or similar)
- Title: h3 a or .job_listing-title
- Link: h3 a[href]
- Location: .location
- Category: .job-type
- Price/Revenue: .job-salary or custom field

To scrape this site, you need to:
1. Use Playwright or Selenium to render JavaScript
2. Wait for ul.job_listings to populate
3. May need to trigger 'Load More' button clicks for pagination
4. Consider using WP REST API endpoint if available
